description: This source file implements the HttpNoVarySearchData class, which manages and compares URL search parameters with respect to 'no-vary' and 'vary' rules, including parsing from HTTP headers.

classes.name: HttpNoVarySearchData
classes.description: Class managing URL search parameter variation rules, including parsing from headers and comparison.

methods.name: AreEquivalent
methods.description: Compares two URLs to determine if they are equivalent under the no-vary search rules.

methods.name: CreateFromNoVaryParams
methods.description: Creates an instance with specified no-vary parameters and key order variation.

methods.name: CreateFromVaryParams
methods.description: Creates an instance with specified vary parameters and key order variation.

methods.name: ParseFromHeaders
methods.description: Parses no-vary search data from HTTP response headers.

methods.name: no_vary_params
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters that do not vary.

methods.name: vary_params
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters that vary.

methods.name: vary_on_key_order
methods.description: Indicates if key order affects URL comparison.

methods.name: vary_by_default
methods.description: Indicates if parameters vary by default.
